qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Carrefour possesses substantial scale across France, Europe, and Latin America, but operates in structurally low-margin grocery and hypermarket formats. In France, it faces fierce price competition from independent cooperatives (E.Leclerc) and hard discounters (Aldi, Lidl). Historical multi-year GAAP ROIC sits at ~5.0-5.8%, falling far short of the 12% hurdle, with operating margins compressed at 2.6-3.0% demonstrating zero pricing power above inflation.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 3b (ROIC 5-6% vs 12% hurdle, REJECT). Structural decline of the French hypermarket format, relentless price competition from E.Leclerc and hard discounters, persistent low operating margins (~2.6-3.0%), and chronic sub-cost-of-capital capital efficiency.
qualitative.evidence: 5-year median GAAP ROIC is ~5.0-5.8% (against 12% hurdle). Recurring operating margins have remained compressed between 2.6% and 3.0% from 2020-2024. Net financial debt stands at €3.78B following acquisitions (Grupo BIG, Cora/Match), with serial restructuring programs failing to generate sustainable economic profit above the cost of capital.
